goal_scope: Complete static application prototypes, not code
notes: 191 IDs are stable: 180 non-alias surfaces plus 11 semantic aliases.
All 180 non-alias surfaces have an actual current image.
129 current PNGs have cited static review/recheck evidence; 51 retain reused_prior_static_audit and are not claimed as newly re-reviewed pixel by pixel.
The 11 aliases have no separate current_image and do not add a drawing target.
The final regression evidence reports 344 application source files and 152 protected original images unchanged, plus 63 archived source/copy version pairs with zero hash differences.
Static PNG evidence does not verify interaction, persistence, permissions, concurrency enforcement, mail/provider behavior, or production service state.
